pages.text: To build a terminal you must start from raw materials. $(br2)The production line is: $(item)Raw Silicon$() > $(item)Silicon Wafer$() > $(item)Logic Wafer$() > $(item)Logic Chip$() > $(item)Circuit Board$() > $(item)Advanced Circuit$() > $(item)Processing Unit$() > $(item)Terminal Core$() > $(item)Terminal Panel$()
The very beginning: smelt $(item)Amethyst Shard$() or $(item)Quartz$() in a furnace to get $(item)Raw Silicon$().
